title: HTTP/1.1 framing and interceptor boundary
summary: Exact routes, GET/POST/HEAD, keep-alive/pipelining, 100-continue and binary-exact bodies are supported with bounded headers/body/counts and conservative framing. Duplicate Content-Length, unsupported Transfer-Encoding, invalid Host/framing and malformed requests fail closed.
invariants: Interceptors see request-local projections, not raw Socket/BIO/SSL/SSL_CTX/Foreign Runtime objects.
Before-hooks are ordered and after-hooks reverse ordered.
Short-circuit and interceptor failure are contained.
